description: Map images to alt text per page
command:
cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import re,html,subprocess
pages=['','about','academics','life-at-michigan','athletics','research','health-medicine','initiatives','giving','facts-figures','contact','about/privacy','schools-colleges','prospective-students','current-students','faculty-staff','parents','alumni']
for p in pages:

    h=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',h,flags=re.S)
    imgs=re.findall(r'<img[^>]*>',h)

        src=re.search(r'src=\"([^\"]*)\"',im)

"
